fidelity: F2a — Ion-Transport Stack Model (Nernst-Planck + salt mass balance ODE)
source: Strathmann (2004) Ion-Exchange Membrane Separation Processes, Elsevier; Strathmann (2010) Desalination 264:268-288; Ortiz et al. (2005) J. Membrane Sci. 252:65-75; Nikonenko et al. (2014) Adv. Colloid Interface Sci. 235:233-246

unit.name: Generic brackish-water electrodialysis stack — physics-lumped ion transport

N_cell_pairs.note: Number of cell pairs (CEM+AEM) in the stack

A_membrane_cm2.note: Effective membrane area per cell pair

t_transport_CEM.note: Counter-ion transport number in cation-exchange membrane

t_transport_AEM.note: Counter-ion transport number in anion-exchange membrane

t_transport_sol.note: Cation transport number in bulk NaCl solution

D_salt_cm2_s.note: NaCl diffusion coefficient in water at 25C (CRC Handbook)

Lambda_eq_S_cm2_mol.note: Equivalent conductivity of NaCl at infinite dilution (Na+ 50.1 + Cl- 76.3)

lambda_factor.note: Empirical fraction of infinite-dilution conductivity at working concentration

current_efficiency_max.note: Stack-level current utilization upper bound (back-diffusion, water transport, leakage)
